qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Installed base across industrial pumps, rotating equipment services, and Chemtech separation systems, but commoditized competition in flow equipment limits pricing power and leaves multi-cycle GAAP ROIC below the 12% hurdle.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC & Pricing Power, REJECT). Industrial pumps and flow equipment face commoditized competition from global pump manufacturers; full-cycle GAAP ROIC sits below the 12% hurdle (ROCE was 5.4% in 2022 and 9.0% in 2021) and cyclical competitive tenders restrict pricing power.
qualitative.evidence: Historical ROCE fluctuated between 5.4% (2022) and 9.0% (2021) before recent cyclical recovery. Competitive bidding in municipal water, oil & gas, and process industries prevents sustained pricing power above inflation.
